Meta.title: Heirloom — digital inheritance without trusting anyone
Meta.description: Leave files to the people you choose. Encrypted in your browser, released only when your guardians agree you are gone.

Verified.verifiedHint: Verified with a zero-knowledge proof of a valid Aadhaar. No Aadhaar data is stored anywhere.

Deployment.unreachableLocal: The local chain isn't answering at http://127.0.0.1:8545.
Deployment.unreachableRemote: The network's RPC endpoint isn't answering. Check your connection and the RPC URL in the app's settings.
Deployment.missingTitle: Heirloom isn't on {where} at the expected address
Deployment.missingBodyNothing: This page expects Heirloom at {address}, but nothing is deployed there.
Deployment.missingBodyOther: This page expects Heirloom at {address}, but a different contract is there.
Deployment.step1: Stop any old npm run dev terminals, then start it once: npm run dev from the project folder.
Deployment.step2: Wait for Heirloom deployed to … in that terminal.
Deployment.step3: Reload this page (Ctrl+Shift+R). A restarted local chain starts empty and gets a fresh deployment, so this page must be reloaded to pick up the new address.
Deployment.outdated: The deployment record in this build is out of date for this network. Redeploy, or rebuild the app with the current contracts.ts.

Waking.title: Waking up the server…
Waking.body: Free hosting puts it to sleep when idle, so the first request can take up to a minute. Your request will still go through.
